text:
Leah: ok team, tight timeline for the benchmark narrative. need a compact set of visuals + messaging for the launch post, blog deep-dive, and webinar. main goal: make infra/platform buyers see the latency vs cost tradeoff we help them control.
Omar: propose we focus on three core claims: predictable latency, optimized unit economics, and resilient fallbacks. short, punchy lines for each.
Priya: also add inbound routing logic for lead qualification — self-serve vs demo vs enterprise. we should tag webinar regs >=50 seats as enterprise interest and capture region.
Noah: visual slate idea: A) two-axis scatter (p95 latency x, normalized $/1k y) with deployment-mode color. B) waterfall/stacked chart showing cost impact of batching + quantization + caching. C) simple flow diagram (fastpath/slowpath routing with % hit rates). webinar should open with C as conceptual model.
Leah: agreed. blog opens with A + callout, deep-dive uses B to show mechanics.
Omar: suggested microcopy for hooks:
- Predictable latency: "Latency you can budget for — SLAs that behave."
- Optimized unit economics: "Reduce per-token spend with smart batching & caching."
- Resilient fallbacks: "Automated fallbacks keep user journeys uninterrupted."
Priya: inbound CSV mapping draft: 
```csv
lead_type,cta,tag,owner
try-self-serve,signup,trial,sd-ops
register-webinar,register,engage,marketing
contact-sales,contact,ent-lead,adr
```
Noah: add rule: webinar registrations with headcount >=50 -> ent-lead. capture region (NA/EU/APAC) as extra field.
bench-bot: data check: median caching reduction across sampled workloads = 32.8%. include as a cautious callout: "~33% median cache reduction (internal eval)". link: https://redwood.internal/bench/171886/summary (internal).
Leah: axis labels: x = "Latency (ms p95)", y = "Normalized cost per 1k tokens". tooltip fields: model, p95_ms, $/1k, throughput. include small legend for deployment mode (hosted, dedicated, private).
Omar: for the scatter callout copy: "Median cache-driven cost drop: ~33% — var by workload." don't over-claim.
Priya: email invite variants (short):
1) "Live: how teams hold latency and lower inference spend — demo + benchmarks."
2) "Predictable inference: lower surprises, better economics with Redwood."
Leah: prefer language "optimize unit economics" over "cut costs" for public lines. Noah echoed that.
Noah: webinar flow: 1) why latency & unit economics matter (2 slides), 2) conceptual model (flow diagram), 3) demo showing scatter + stacked cost breakdown, 4) customer vignette, 5) Q&A + CTAs.
Omar: i'll drop a scatter mock by EOD Monday, Priya will wire routing into marketing automation, Noah will build slides and schedule dry run Wed.
Priya: creating webhook to notify #sales-inbound for ent-leads.
Leah: final ask: drop assets into shared folder and ping here when done. thanks! :rocket:
